notes.title: Exciting News! New Demo Release + Taipei Game Show 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169269/2246a0d6b86dbd7c40bc681030455420b5fa46f8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169269/23651fd40c23a6914fc9d3cc058aa53f2929bcc1.png[/img]

We’re thrilled to share some big updates with you! Our team has been hard at work, and we’re finally ready to unveil two exciting announcements:

1. New Demo Now Available

Get ready to embark on a journey into our game world with our brand-new demo, now live on Steam! Whether you’re a fan of intense battles, immersive storytelling, or exploring a vibrant world, this demo offers a glimpse into the experience we’re crafting just for you.

Your feedback means the world to us, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts and let us know what you’d love to see improved or expanded.

2. We’re Going to Taipei Game Show 2025!

We’re excited to announce that our game will be featured at the Taipei Game Show 2025 online event, happening from 23 to 26 January 2025.

We’ll also have a few surprises lined up, so don’t miss this chance to experience the magic firsthand!

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, happy gaming!

Warm regards,
Twilight Studio

notes.title: Play Twilight Memoria: Freedom Demo as part of PixElated Festival!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169269/7eabfc803f2d8bed3d95bee9f6b226471e6e5843.png[/img]

We [b]love[/b] pixel art games, and we know you do too. So, let’s celebrate together 🎉 We’re super excited to share that [b]Twilight Memoria: Freedom[/b] joins PixElated Festival next week! This festival is featuring some of the best pixel art games on Steam. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems all in one place!

There will be ✨ discounts ✨ live streams ✨ art contest ✨ demos✨ developer chats ✨ all centered around your favorite games.

Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: http://pixelatedfest.com/
